import_questions.text: Your wolfe-health server's Tailscale IPv4 address and port, then /summary.txt (http://100.x.y.z:8090/summary.txt)

params.WFCommentActionText: Say "Hey Siri, how did I sleep": it fetches the morning's figures from the wolfe-health server (/summary.txt) and reads them aloud: sleep score and its change, time asleep, readiness, and what held either back. Needs the server reachable (home network, or Tailscale on the phone); if it isn't, this step fails and iOS says so. It also suits an automation: Alarm is stopped, or Sleep Focus turns off.
